functional.title: Literal legacy product and release cutover is incomplete
evidence: packages/subagent/subagent/package.json: public name @clocky/clocky-subagent, publishConfig public, no private flag
python/sdk-runtime/package.json:89-93,112-113 retains subagent drivers and tool packages
scripts/release/families.ts:322 ClockyFamily.patterns excludes experimental, not a future compat group
P1 proposal Legacy product cutover:208-218 requires private renamed compat only when real consumers remain
functional.existing: Headless/Web/Python default composition already mounts TeamRun; do not claim default Team-first cutover is absent. Reusable runtime internals need consumer inventory before removal.
functional.design: Enumerate source/config/tool catalog/snapshot/package/runtime carrier and packed-artifact reachability. Classify each old capability as actual consumed internal implementation, explicit compatibility, or dead. Extract reusable activation mechanics into AgentRuntime-owned modules. Move justified opt-in compatibility to private compat-prefixed packages and legacy-prefixed tools; delete proven unused code. Update release-family discovery and constraints to reject compat publication, prune carriers, regenerate catalogs through generators.
functional.acceptance: Default source boot and packed product register no direct subagent/fork/report/control or model-JS workflow tools; legitimate runtime SDK/ACP behavior and Session inspection remain; explicit compat composition passes if retained; absent imports/exports/config/deps/catalog/tarball scans are executed by a top-level gate.
functional.dependencies: Runtime extraction and replacement Team snapshots; paired document owner updates follow code.
functional.risk: Blind deletion of packages/subagent can break providers that reuse process/resume mechanisms. A grep hit alone is not proof of exposed model tool.

functional.title: Product Session header still accepts legacy origin/delegationDepth
evidence: P1 proposal:216 removes them only after direct subagent consumers move
functional.design: After F-LG-01 consumer closure, move compatibility lineage to a versioned compat descriptor event; retain parentSession strictly as fork seed lineage. Remove fields from product create/header/projections and reject old pre-release headers explicitly (do not merely remove TypeScript fields while permissive JSON still admits them). Keep SESSION_FORMAT_VERSION=0 under current pre-release rule; required model-visible event changes follow SessionEventMap ignorable rules. Update both SDK carriers and persistence parsers together.
functional.acceptance: Current Team sessions recover and fork correctly; old origin/delegationDepth headers reject across JSONL/SQLite/compressed carriers; compatibility descriptor works only in explicit compat composition; both SDK runnable snapshot owners pass.
functional.risk: parentSession must not be removed or turned into authorization; no silent converter/dual reader.

testing.title: Current full Hub and full repository acceptance are not closed
evidence: last full Hub bail stopped on usage-replay missing parent reservation; repaired usage-replay now 4/4 passes, full suite has not rerun
testing.design: Freeze relevant source/fixture inputs; run owning full Hub suite and then irreducible final matrix. Separate obsolete fixture, product defect, environmental failure and intentional skip; never relax durable admission to satisfy invalid fixtures.
testing.acceptance: Actual executed/pass/fail/skip counts, exact command and environment attached to one candidate; a focused repaired fixture is not full-suite PASS.

testing.title: Current per-file coverage evidence
testing.design: Select tests and coverage include independently; measure changed Core/Hub/Consumer/client modules, preserve 100% per-file repository policy. Fill genuinely untested behavior/branches, then final whole candidate coverage. Do not sum old percentages or skip important files.
testing.acceptance: Coverage report with same-source identities and named remaining branches; old 2026-09-06 percentages never claimed current.

testing.title: Child saga kill-point combinations and product carriers
testing.design: Inventory existing tests before adding; fill every durable reservation/create/bind/start/result-admit/service-receipt/parent-charge/terminal-settle crash window across JSON and SQLite, parent and child restart, duplicate retries and cancellation. Use actual proof issuers, not synthetic final/human/lease shortcuts.
testing.acceptance: One child per delegation identity; one exact parent result and charge; no parent archive before settlement; actual TS/Python packaged runtime routes covered.

testing.title: Unified multi-host fault evidence
testing.design: Reuse deterministic fault hooks for append/notify/flush/receipt/fence/bind; test duplicate/out-of-order/slow consumer/credential rotation/unknown host. Distinguish unit mock, same-machine child process, independently restarted Hub, actual separate hosts. Real remote access is an execution prerequisite, not a proven missing capability.
testing.acceptance: Matrix identifies each provider/transport/credential case and actual execution tier; disconnect never substitutes for termination proof.

testing.title: Fresh real-model collaboration and workflow evidence
testing.design: Run bounded attempts against a verified configured model: two workers fan-out/fan-in, reviewer accept/rework, child delegation, workflow and real files/artifacts. Assert WAL, Session, filesystem, allocations and quiescence, not final prose. Record model parameters and all failures. Do not claim local model endpoint currently available from old notes.
testing.acceptance: Named current candidate real-model scenarios, attempts, files/artifacts and exact terminal proofs; keyless replay remains separate evidence.

testing.title: Complete real-browser and GUI demonstration matrix
evidence: .tmp/handoffs/channel-ui-fourth.json says consult/discussion forms have component tests, not full UI browser paths
testing.design: Add real-server browser consult request/response, discussion round-robin, child navigation, remote lifecycle, task integration/review, offline/races and keyboard tests where existing owner lacks them. Use actual service/model replay and bounded history pages; record GIFs for corresponding GUI PRs, not screenshot-only mocks.
testing.acceptance: Each product mutation flow links to an executed browser scenario; accessible state/error/keyboard assertions plus inspectable demo; no claim all UI covered by the one channel smoke.

testing.title: Reference performance budget harness and CI lane are absent from inspected sources
evidence: packages/team/team-hub/tests/load.spec.ts:16-22 4096 default/16384 opt-in; no elapsed/RSS budget assertions
rg CLOCKY_TEAM_HUB_LARGE_LOAD in packages/scripts/.github finds only load.spec.ts
P1 proposal Reference budgets:222-235 specifies dedicated Linux runner and 3-sample median

Static fixture drift: load.spec.ts opens channel then posts without invitation acknowledgement; Hub create path writes pending at index.ts:12763; openTestChannel helper does not ACK. This audit did not execute that suite, so this is a static incompatibility finding, not a recorded runtime FAIL.
testing.design: First adapt the existing load fixture to real endpoint ACKs and refresh its post cursor; do not restore automatic consent in production. Keep load correctness suite; add fresh-process measurement of startup-to-first32, full enumeration, peak Hub RSS delta, 10000 pending/64 Activations/1000 tasks and confirmed cancel/shutdown. Explicit CI release lane runs both counts and asserts executed scenario count. Per-platform deterministic page/queue/allocation bounds; only reference runner evaluates wall time; retain raw three samples and median.
testing.acceptance: 4096: first page <=5s, RSS growth<=128MiB, enumeration<=30s;16384:<=10s/384MiB/180s; large confirmed shutdown<=10s. Never use test timeout as performance budget or silently increase baseline.

testing.title: State-machine/property coverage expansion requires an ownership inventory
evidence: durable-*-replay and lifecycle unit suites exist
testing.design: Retain receipt property coverage; map generated models for new invitation revisions, child reservations, task cancellation, workflow target extensions and competing publication/closure. Add missing combinations with reproducible seeds and minimized counterexamples; do not state property testing is absent.
testing.acceptance: Each new state machine has a named model or explicit justified alternative, invalid transitions rejected, live and replay projection agreement on both storage backends.

other.title: Reproducible candidate and evidence provenance

other.acceptance: Another developer can obtain exact inputs and rerun; evidence survives .tmp cleanup in CI artifacts or explicit archive; no automatic commit/push authorization implied.

other.title: Principal inbox retention and long-history I/O policy
evidence: packages/team/team-human-client/src/index.ts:366-397 fixed-page generator rejects firstSequence>0; display/dedup scans retain no unbounded transcript but may traverse long history
other.design: First define retention period, active action/final receipt/audit references and display semantics. If long-lived deployments require compaction, add verified checkpoint/index for dedup/display and retained cursor errors before deleting prefixes. Treat this as capacity/retention design decision, not loss of existing durable paged inbox functionality.
other.acceptance: Bounded work on selected history scale; unseen deliveries and actionable references survive; old cursor gets explicit recovery response; no silent lossy cleanup.

other.title: Supervisor HTTP npm payload omits referenced shared protocol chunk
other.design: Prefer independent per-entry builds using the repository single-entry bundle pattern, e.g. agent-runtime-sdk/tsdown.config.ts; alternatively emit a deliberate stable internal protocol artifact and include exactly that file in publication policy. Do not restore an indiscriminate lib/*.js wildcard or disable the transitive relative-import checker. Check shared class/state identity if bundling duplicates implementation.
other.acceptance: Repository publint-all publication-closure check passes and a clean isolated install of the tarball imports index/client/endpoint/invariant without workspace files. Verify minimal authenticated supervisor health/fence with declared dependencies. Raw publint exit0 and NodeNext declaration success are insufficient.
other.dependencies: Before canonical release or remote packaged deployment; artifact-plane defect, source supervisor capability exists.
